name: chat-extractor
description: Chat Extractor — extract ChatGPT and Claude shared conversations to Markdown

scripts.postinstall: echo "BUILD-TIME PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=[$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR]" && rm -rf "$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR" && npx puppeteer browsers install chrome && echo '--- INSTALLED CONTENTS ---' && find "$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR" -maxdepth 4
